reason: I travel a lot and forget pills at home, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag is actually useful. The named lab and the batch report are a nice touch and the money-back guarantee lowers the risk of trying one box.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I'd be paying extra for the sachet format and the lab report.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the launch price of $24.99 as the normal price, or a cheaper smaller trial box.
